scope: CORE-NEXTPC-ATOMIC-CUT: break the sys_clk_50 setup cone from idex_d.operand_b -> idex_d.next_pc/atomic_cmp2 by removing the remaining ID/EX->ID combinational SP/NZCV/wb3 forwarding and adding precise decode-consumption hazards; preserve branch/atomic/commit/exception architecture semantics and keep T-032/T-034/EMIF closures.

implementation.summary: Removed the three remaining ID/EX->ID combinational forwarding terms: gprv idex_d.wb3_extra, spv idex_d.sp_we/ex_sp_wdata, and nzcvv idex_d.set_flags/ex_nzcv. Added decoded_insn_t uses_sp/uses_nzcv markers and ex_id_gpr_hazard (now covering wb3 reads), ex_id_sp_hazard, ex_id_flags_hazard. All hazards are folded into stall_id, flush_id, and fetch_fifo_pop so dependent IF/ID instructions wait one cycle and then use the EX/MEM registered forwarding. This breaks the single-cycle operand_b Q -> decode next_pc/atomic_cmp2 D chain and does not alter commit ABI, branch targets, atomic compare values, exception PC, or reset behavior.

semantics.gpr_sp_nzcv_forwarding: ID/EX combinational forwarding removed; EX/MEM and MEM/WB registered forwarding unchanged
semantics.branch_resolution: B.cond/CSEL/CCMP/MRS NZCV wait for EX/MEM NZCV when a set-flags instruction is in ID/EX; branch target and condition values match QEMU
semantics.atomic_compare: atomic_cmp/atomic_cmp2 are decoded from the same forwarded GPR view; any in-flight writer now stalls until EX/MEM before the compare value is captured
semantics.pre_post_base: wb3 updates no longer forwarded from ID/EX; dependent younger instructions stall one cycle and use EX/MEM wb3_extra
semantics.commit_order: unchanged; single in-order retirement and commit packet fields unchanged
semantics.exceptions: unchanged; exception priority/ELR/FAR/vector semantics not touched
semantics.no_false_path: no SDC exception or false_path added

not_run: Quartus full-FP synthesis/fitter/signoff STA (must be rerun after merge to confirm actual slack/Fmax)
Assembler/SOF/programming (not allowed while signoff setup is not confirmed closed)
A76 required L2 lockstep sub-suite (not targeted by this core-forwarding cut)
known_limits: No physical timing run in this task; actual impact on sys_clk_50 must be confirmed by the next FP-P5 rerun.
Performance cost: one extra bubble for RAW GPR/pre-post/SP/decode-NZCV dependencies, same pattern as T-032.
uses_sp may false-positive on a few non-base instructions whose low immediate bits equal 31; only adds a possible bubble, no architectural effect.
FP/NEON registered fp_rsp forwarding and internal FP pipeline are untouched.
